description: Wording for the two copy-message buttons in index.html: the per-member '复制付款消息' (payment message) and the '📢 复制到货通知' (group arrival announcement, at the top of the page). Edit THIS file to change how either message reads — do not edit index.html for wording changes. {placeholders} are filled in automatically from real data (product name, quantity, unit, amount, adjustment note, actual weight, total, member names, pickup location) — keep them in the text, just move/reword what's around them. Re-upload this file to the repo root to apply changes; no index.html edit or redeploy of the app itself needed. Payment-message style matches how WG团购群 already writes these by hand: "@name", no emoji, no "$", blank line before the item list and before the total, "一共X～" instead of "合计：$X", and no closing line by default. The group announcement mentions every member (`mentionPrefix`/`mentionSeparator`), then `groupAnnouncementText` with `{arrived}` (what showed up — from that round's data-<date>.json `itemsLabel`, or every product label joined by 、 if that's not set) and `{location}` (from `pickupLocation` below — your unit number, stays constant across rounds unless you move).
groupAnnouncementText: {arrived}到啦，欢迎来{location}自取，需要送货小群联系～
